name: Indian Idol
description: The Indian version of the Pop Idol format.

videos.title: The Journey Begins in the City of Joy
videos.overview: Indian Idol is back with its 10th season and this time the task of finding India's next big singing sensation is helmed by music composer and singer Vishal Dadlani, singer Neha Kakkar, and ace music director Anu Malik. The auditions kick start in the City of Joy, Kolkata, with a few singers delivering outstanding performances.

videos.title: Dilwalon Ki Delhi
videos.overview: Next stop Delhi. Indian Idol is back for the 10th season and it’s time for Delhi to show the judges Vishal Dadlani, Neha Kakkar, Anu Malik what is Delhi really made of, soulful voices and skillful melodies. Tonight’s episode will take the audience on the highs and lows of music as well as our contestant’s lives. Experience music like nowhere else, and what Delhi has to offer is surprisingly amazing.

videos.title: Musical Mumbai
videos.overview: Indian Idol auditions move to the city of dreams, Mumbai. To fulfill their dreams, contestants throng the auditions to showcase their talent in front of the judges and the world. Some contestants have risen above prejudice, while others have defied the odds to reach the auditions. The contestants and their gifted singing abilities turn Mumbai musical.

videos.title: Talent Shines Again
videos.overview: With another day comes much more amazing talents on the second day of the Mumbai auditions. Judge Vishal makes it a lot tougher for the contestants as he expects the best of the best to qualify. Host Manish Paul has a lot of fun with the contestants and the judges. Watch the episode for more fun and to see who qualifies for the next round on the last day of the auditions.

videos.title: Run For The Top Twelve
videos.overview: It's the theater round and from the top thirty contestants, the judges have to make a quick and drastic decision to cut off eighteen of the contestants and select only twelve! Contestants from every part of the country fight it out to be on top. Judges Neha, Vishal and Anu now have to take crucial decisions, as all of the singers are top notch. More music, melody and might wait in tonight’s episode.

videos.title: Fight For The Nine Golden Mikes
videos.overview: It's the theater round on Indian Idol Season 10 and from twelve there are only nine golden mikes left. Judges Anu, Neha, and Vishal discuss that this season of Indian Idol has seen the best performers in all of Indian Idol history. Talent from every corner of the country unites on this very stage to blow the minds with their musical skills.

videos.title: A Night To Remember
videos.overview: It’s the grand premier round of Indian Idol season 10. Our judges Neha, Anu, and Vishal enter with a banging performance. In today’s episode, we have our contestants singing their hearts out but wait for it. A handful of celebrity guest singers will join out contestants on stage and comment on their performances. It’s a night to enjoy, so embrace this musical journey and let the melodies fill your hearts.

videos.title: The Remaining Seven Super Singers
videos.overview: It’s the second day of the Grand Premiere round of Indian Idol Season 10. Still, seven of the top singers have been waiting for their turn, and in tonight’s episode, it’s a phenomenal blast as these contestants are joined by very popular celebrity singers. Our judges Neha, Anu, and Vishal are as always boosting the constants to pinch out their supreme best melodies. It’s a rhythmic night ahead so, sit back and relax to witness a harmonious voyage.

videos.title: A Night of Mesmerising Performances by Top 14
videos.overview: The Top 14 contestants deliver mesmerizing performances in front of the team of Fanney Khan: Aishwarya Rai, Anil Kapoor, and Rajkummar Rao. Performances by Salman Ali, Soumya Chakraborty, Renu Nagar, and Ankush Bharadwaj leave the judges impressed. Who will remain and move into the next round?

videos.title: The Legend Kamal Haasan Is Here
videos.overview: In tonight’s episode of Indian Idol Season 10, the legend, the ever-so phenomenal, all-rounder Mr. Kamal Haasan joins our panel. As the contestants out-perform each other with their majestic voices and soulful harmonies, Mr. Haasan shares his opinions on them, and a few of his amazing life experiences. Our panel full of talented judges, Neha, Vishal and Anu critic our contestants to bring out the best in them.

videos.title: Musically Gifted
videos.overview: Exceptional performances, outstanding singing, and an entertaining night, that's the gist of tonight's episode of Indian Idol. And to witness these fabulous singers from close quarters are Sonakshi Sinha and Jassi Gill. Watch Soumya playing with the musical notes, Renu Nagar delivering an outstanding performance, and Ankush winning hearts in this episode.

videos.title: The Celebration Continues
videos.overview: In tonight’s episode of Indian Idol Season 10, it’s time for our contestants to bring their family along. Our phenomenal judges Neha, Anu and Vishal has lots to offer for our contestants, but wait, super celebrity guest John Abraham and Manoj Bajpai is here to enjoy and comment on our top performers.

videos.title: Folk Challaenge
videos.overview: Indian Idol contestants have to up the ante and tread on the simple but complicated path of folk singing to show their versatility. The singers have to match up to the expectations of the judges and also leave a lasting impression on the special guest Manoj Tiwari in tonight's episode that celebrates folk singing.

videos.title: The Folk Challenge Continues
videos.overview: In this special folk-round of Indian Idol, special celebrity guest singer Gurdas Maan presents himself of his amazing stage. Watch as our contestants will perform will their hearts out. Judges Anu, Vishal and Neha will cheer them all the way. Watch the phenomenal episode and take this musical journey.

videos.title: A Date With The Dashing Deols
videos.overview: Bollywood Legend Dharmendra and his sons - Sunny and Bobby Deol - light up the atmosphere of Indian Idol with their electrifying presence. Indian Idol contestants pay a heartwarming tribute to the icon Dharmendra by singing his timeless songs.

videos.title: Rakhi Special
videos.overview: In tonight's episode, Indian Idol contestants celebrate Raksha Bandhan. Making a special appearance on the episode is Sonu Kakkar. Performances by Avanti Patel, Ankush, and Salman Ali get noteworthy appreciation from the judges.

videos.title: An Evening of Unparalleled Performances
videos.overview: In this episode of Indian Idol, the contestants deliver performances that have never been seen before. Salman Ali delivers another spectacular performance, while Vibhor turns a rockstar with an entertaining performance. With each contestant outperforming the other, who will be declared the performer of the day?

videos.title: The Icons Light Up The Stage
videos.overview: In tonight's episode, the Indian Idol contestants get to perform before Sonu Nigam, Javed Akhtar, and J. P. Dutta. Ankush sings a heart touching song before his idol, Sonu Nigam. Nitin steals the show with a spectacular performance. The journey gets tougher as one contestant bids adieu tonight.

videos.title: Varun Dhawan and Anushka Sharma Witness Splendid Performances
videos.overview: Varun Dhawan and Anushka Sharma are special guests on tonight's episode of Indian Idol. The contestants deliver spectacular performances that leave the judges and the special guests awe-struck. Salman Ali leaves everyone in tears with a soulful singing, while Kunal sings like he never has before.

videos.title: The 90’s King and Queen
videos.overview: In Tonight’s episode everyone is in the classic mood and to enhance the experience a little emore, the phenomenal singers Akla Yagnik and Kumar Shanu joins the stage. Watch as our contestants sing their hearts out and our special guest judges getting surprised by their potential.

videos.title: Ganapati Special
videos.overview: Indian Idol celebrates Ganesh Chaturthi with fervor. Joining the celebrations are music composer duo Ajay-Atul. Making a special appearance on the show is actress Supriya Pilgaonkar. Witness the magical performances by Salman Ali, Neelanjana, and Avanti Patel in this episode of Indian Idol.

videos.title: The Celebration Continues
videos.overview: The Ganpati celebration continues as Shahid Kapoor and Shraddha Kapoor joins the fun, it’s the atmosphere of music and joy. Last night’s special guests are also here to witness the contestants from tonight.

videos.title: A Tribute to Motherhood
videos.overview: In this episode, Indian Idol contestants pay a tribute to motherhood. The unspoken words that have remained locked in the hearts will be expressed through music by the Indian Idol contestants to their mothers.

videos.title: Shaadi Special
videos.overview: In tonight's episode, Sunil Grover, Vishal Bharadwaj, and Rekha Bhardwaj are speical guests. Renu Nagar impresses Rekha Bhardwaj with her outstanding singing, while Neelanjana adds a touch of perfection and gives a brilliant performance. Salman Ali is once again named the performer of the day following a spectacular singing performance.

videos.title: Fun With Salman Khan, Aayush Sharma, and Warina Hussain
videos.overview: Indian Idol gets star-studded tonight thanks to the presence of Salman Khan, Aayush Sharma, and Warina Hussain. Salman Ali, Nitin, and Neelanjana impress the stars and the judges with their amazing performances.

videos.title: Please Welcome Govinda
videos.overview: In tonight’s episode of Indian Idol, it’s comedy and music hand in hand, special guest Govinda is here tonight, and everyone is out-bounds happy. The performances continue as our musical genius contestants will rock the stage, and our special guest Govinda will make you laugh your head off. Our judges Neha, Vishal and Anu are with the contestants, cheering them all the way through.

videos.title: Night of Music With Ajay Devgn and Kajol
videos.overview: In tonight's episode, Indian Idol contestants sing duet songs. To watch them fill the night with music are Ajay Devgn and Kajol. So who will impress the judges and the speical guests tonight? And who will be named the best performer of the day?

videos.title: Duet Challenge With Kumar Sanu
videos.overview: The iconic Kumar Sanu is here tonight to sing duet songs with Indian Idol contestants. Relive the magic of Kumar Sanu's iconic songs and watch Indian Idol contestants recreate the magic weaved by the iconic singer.

videos.title: Navratri Special With Richa Sharma and Ayushmann Khurrana
videos.overview: Indian Idol celebrates Navratri in presence of singer Richa Sharma and actor Ayushmann Khurrana. Indian Idol contestants, in a traditional attire, bring alive the festive atmosphere on stage and deliver truly mesmerizing performances.

videos.title: Musical Night With Arjun Kapoor and Parineeti Chopra
videos.overview: Indian Idol contestants leave tonight's special guests, Arjun Kapoor, and Parineeti Chopra, in awe of their performance. While delivering truly mesmerizing performances. Salman Ali and Nitin weave magic with their fabulous voices, while Vibhor and Soumya Chakraborty, along with Avanti and Renu Nagar set the stage on fire with their rocking performances.

videos.title: Relive Classic Melodies With Pyarelal
videos.overview: The special guest of tonight's episode of Indian Idol is Pyarelal of the Laxmikant–Pyarelal fame. The iconic songs composed by music composer duo Laxmikant–Pyarelal will be sung by Indian Idol contestants in front of Pyarelal, who is on the panel. These iconic songs will test the contestants' talent as they have to perform with the live orchestra.

videos.title: Fan Special
videos.overview: Tonight's episode sees Indian Idol Top 8 contestants singing songs that are chosen by their loyal fan base. Each contestant's song is chosen based on their singing style. Neelanjana, Salman Ali, Ankush, and Soumya Chakrabortty stand out by delivering one of their best performances.

videos.title: Vishal Challenge
videos.overview: Indian Idol contestants will sing along with Vishal Dadlani. Judging along with Neha Kakkar are music composer duo Salim–Sulaiman. Indian Idol contestants have to up the ante as Vishal be challenging them on every beat. Will Indian Idol contestants be successful in the Vishal Dadlani's challenge?

videos.title: Qawali Challenge
videos.overview: It’s Qawali special in tonight’s episode of Indian Idol. Watch as our superstar contestants blow up the stage with their phenomenal voices and pitch-perfect melodies. Judges Vishal and Neha are surprised to see how well these performers can sing. They surely have it in them.

videos.title: Diwali Special
videos.overview: Tonight in Indian Idol, it's Diwali Special and look who is here, a new judge Javed Ali. He is one of the best and top play-back singers from our generation. Also our special guest tonight is Baba Ramdev. Sit back relax and enjoy this musical journey.

videos.title: The Golden Bappi Lahiri
videos.overview: On this festive mood of Diwali, Indian Idol stage is proud to welcome one of the best and most remembered singers from the golden generation Bappi Da. He is here to watch, enjoy and critic on our contestants tonight. It's a fun, musical journey ahead. Sit back relax and go deep into this ocean of music.

videos.title: The Evergreen Jeetendra
videos.overview: Tonight this Indian Idol Stage will get enlightened with the presence of the evergreen superstar Jeetendra. This actor has dedicated so much of his life into this countries movie industry, so it's time that tonight we devote him this gift of music. Back to back songs from his hit movies.

videos.title: Party With Neha
videos.overview: Tonight on this very special episode, everything that you see is dedicated to Neha. Once she was a contestant of this very stage and her hard work and will power has taken her from this side of the stage to that. She has become a judge of this show. We are very proud of you Neha. Watch this episode as Neha joins each and every contestant on stage and boost their morale with a touch of her voice.

videos.title: A Musical Night With Usha Uthup
videos.overview: The one and only Usha Uthup graces the Indian Idol stage in tonight's episode. The contestants deliver one fabulous performance after the other in front of the legend Usha Uthup. Kunal gives an outstanding tribute to the King of Pop Michael Jackson, while Ankush pays a glorious tribute to the legend Mohammed Rafi. Sit back and enjoy this musical night with the melodious Usha Uthup.

videos.title: Papa Special With Sara And Sushant
videos.overview: Please Welcome our special guests for tonight, Sara Ali Khan and Sushant Singh Rajput. Both are top notch celebrities and have acted in numerous movies. With us we also have Usha Uthup as a guest judge. On this very day, we have orchestrated a tribute to all the dads around. Their hard work and dedication is the reason, for our success today. So with a grateful attitude and a salute, let's start this musical journey.

videos.title: Welcome Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah Family
videos.overview: The entire cast of the popular show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah is here tonight to cheer their favorite Indian Idol contestants. The Gokuldham society members witness amazing performances from the contestants. So, sit back and enjoy this fun-filled episode with the cast of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah.

videos.title: Welcome Zeenat Aman
videos.overview: Tonight on this very special episode of Indian Idol Season 10. We have the one and only Zeenat Aman, a superstar from the golden era. She is an unstoppable woman with various skills and talent. She is here tonight to witness our Idols and enjoy the magical beats of this epic show.

videos.title: Saturday Night With Kapil Sharma
videos.overview: The king of comedy, Kapil Sharma, is here tonight to entertain and be entertained by the fabulous performances of Indian Idol contestants. Kapil Sharma gets mesmerized by the breathtaking performances by Vibhor, Salman Ali, Nitin, and Neelanjana.

videos.title: Please Welcome Kumar Sanu
videos.overview: In tonight's episode of Indian Idol, please welcome the phenomenal Kumar Sanu. He is here to perform a medley of his greatest hits and joining our contestants on every step of the way.

videos.title: Please Welcome Randhir Kapoor
videos.overview: In tonight's episode, we welcome Randhir Kapoor. One of the most influential men in Bollywood. He is an actor, director, and producer as well. The way he can judge our contestants, probably no one can. So enjoy this musical night and our idols delivering back-to-back power-packed performances.

videos.title: Badshah The King
videos.overview: In tonight's episode, we welcome Badshah, one of the most prominent musicians of this era. Watch as our contestants sing their hearts out and guest judge Badshah with his compliments.

videos.title: A Night To Remember
videos.overview: In tonight's episode, please welcome, the gorgeous actress Sara Ali Khan, the fearsome Rohit Shetty and the superstar Ranveer Singh. It's a night of music, dance, and fun.

videos.title: Semi-Finale With Udit Narayan
videos.overview: It's the Semi-Finale week, and everyone is excited. Only the top five contestants remain and they have to outdo themselves to prove their worth. Who will stay and who will go? Joining us today is the super talented, singer, composer and lyricist Sir Udit Narayan. Watch as the Idols deliver their best.

videos.title: Pre-Finale
videos.overview: As Indian Idol season 10 is edging towards the grand finale, here is another episode filled with fabulous performances by the enigmatic Indian Idol contestants. Gear up for the blockbuster finale with this amazing pre-finale episode of Indian Idol.

videos.title: The Grand Finale
videos.overview: It's time today farewell to this amazing singing competition which has build careers for so many people. This year the title goes to the well deserved Salman Ali. Watch as the cast of Zero, appears with us on stage, not just them, there are more celeb appliances and beautiful musical performances waiting. So sit back relax and watch the final episode of your favorite show for one last time this year.

videos.title: The Search Begins In Mumbai
videos.overview: This season of Indian Idol beckons a wide range of singing aspirants hailing from Mumbai. The judges viz. Vishal Dadlani, Anu Malik and Neha Kakkar are excited to see the contestants showcase their talent in the house. So, get ready for the most awaited singing reality show of the nation.

videos.title: Arrival At The Capital
videos.overview: The search continues in the capital of India. The people from Delhi are all excited about the contest. Some amazing singers display their talent. There is a hint of fun as well. Watch how a girl wins her direct entry to the Theater Round.

videos.title: A Tuneful Evening
videos.overview: The judges in today's episode continue the hunt primarily in north India where they get to see performances of varied flavors. From the excited Punjabis to the intense vocalists, the entire episode is full of fun and energy.

videos.title: Evening At The City Of Joy
videos.overview: In today's episode, the judges continue their search for new talents in the city of joy, Kolkata. Many contestants show their talent and get a chance to continue their journey and many got rejected but in between them, some funny and cranky moments happens.

videos.title: Theatre Round
videos.overview: It's the theatre round of auditions where the contestants will fight for the top 14 places. All the contestants explore the Dadasaheb Phalke Chitranagari and are excited about the theatre round auditions.

videos.title: Diwali Special
videos.overview: Contestants are excited for the theatre round that continues today. They even get an opportunity to visit the mesmerizing sets of KBC. Get ready for a festive evening full of soulful tunes.

videos.title: Great Grand Premiere
videos.overview: Finally, the Great Grand Premiere episode is here where the top 15 contestants will be participating and contesting for the title. Later the judges get their welcome and the singers show their talents.

videos.title: The Premiere Continues
videos.overview: The Grand Premiere goes on and the contestants sing mesmerizingly. The judges also come up and have some fun with the contestants. Vishal goes on to take selfies with Chelsi's mother.

videos.title: War Of Duos
videos.overview: Today's show starts with the judges announcing the voting facility for the audiences. All the contestants sing the song of their regional language along with a celebrity singer and make the show more colourful.

videos.title: The War Of Duos Continues
videos.overview: Today's show starts with the beginning performance of Shahzaan Mujeeb with the renowned Bollywood singer Shahid Mallya and the judges get overwhelmed from the beginning. Later other participants perform and are having fun along with the judges.

videos.title: Celebrating The Night With Legendary Pyarelal
videos.overview: The evening starts with the grand welcome of Legendary musician Pyarelal and his wife. Following the same, the judges and the contestants give their best to make the evening more special. The participants perform the songs in honor of legend Pyarelal.

videos.title: The Laxmikant Pyarelal Special
videos.overview: Today's evening is again graced by the presence of the legendary music director Mr Pyarelal Ramprasad Sharma from Laxmikant Pyarelal and his wife Mrs Sunila Sharma. The contestants compete for the top ten positions of Indian Idol. Later the hosts also welcome the singer with a truly romantic voice, Mr Shailendra Singh.

videos.title: Ajay Atul Special
videos.overview: This beautiful evening, Aditya along with the judges welcome the guests of the evening Ajay and Atul. Both the brothers share their feeling for the show and enjoys the performance of the participants.

videos.title: Playback Time With Ajay Atul
videos.overview: Today's episode, the continuation of yesterday's with the same brother duo Ajay Atul has even more surprises. The contestants are performing with all energy and try to secure their position in Top 10. Finally, the stage of Indian Idol Season 11 is getting its, Top 10 contestants.

videos.title: Welcoming Brothers Duo Jatin-Lalit
videos.overview: The show begins with the welcome of the Legendary music composer duo Jatin-Lalit. Later the top 10 contestants perform the songs composed by the duo and get appreciated by the judges. Jatin-Lalit also shares their feelings on the stage and appreciates the effort of the participants.

videos.title: The Mother's Special
videos.overview: The show starts with the welcoming of the star cast of the upcoming movie Pati Patni Aur Woh, Kartik Aaryan, Ananya Panday and, Bhumi Pednekar. Today's episode is the mother's special show. The show has a rain of relations today with the theme and also the star cast of the movie "Pati Patni Aur Woh".

videos.title: Evening With The 90s Golden Duo
videos.overview: Today's show starts with the welcome of the Bollywood's best Duo of the '90s for playback singing, Kumar Sanu and Anuradha Paudwal. Afterward, Himesh Reshammiya joins the show as the 3rd judge and the contestants start performing to get better points to secure their position. In the end, one of the contestants gets eliminated.

videos.title: A Duet Challenge
videos.overview: On the special request of Kumar Sanu, today's episode is a Duet Challenge episode. Some of the contestants share their chemistry pretty well on stage, while some take it up a notch. The night is full of ecstatic and wonderful performances.

videos.title: Evergreen Jodi Special
videos.overview: Today's episode has special guests in the all-time popular Bollywood pair, Dharmendra and Asha Parekh. They are given a seat at the judges' table. The contestants sing amazing songs and impress the Jodi. From time to time these golden people of Bollywood share a few of their memories with the audience. Later the set also arranged for the recreating of the magic between Dharmendra and Asha Parekh.

videos.title: Super Eight Special
videos.overview: Alka Yagnik and the top contestants from Super Star Singer make a grand entrance at the Indian Idol stage tonight. They are here to collaborate with the Indian Idol contestants and make the evening more special. The super eight performers are each going to perform with one of the kids who have come as guests.

videos.title: Shaadi Special
videos.overview: The episode begins with the welcoming of Bharti and Haarsh to the sets of Indian Idol. The contestants perform magnificently. Everyone sings along for their beloved person. Bharti makes the evening more bright and lively. Adriz also has a makeover and he looks entirely different.

videos.title: Kishore Kumar Special
videos.overview: The beautiful evening starts with the welcome of family members of Kishore Kumar. All the participants along with the judges appreciate the songs sung by Kishore Kumar and remind him. Leena Chandavarkar appreciates the talents and blesses them with luck. Even the participants give their best and make the evening more colorful.

videos.title: Idols Ki Takkar
videos.overview: The episode starts this evening with the welcoming of the top stars from the last season. They are given a warm welcome. Later the top seven contestants perform with one of their seniors. The duets are amazing and the performers complement each other well.

videos.title: Family Special
videos.overview: Today's episode celebrates the essence of family and their importance in our lives. To celebrate this the set welcomes Ajay Devgn and Kajol this evening. The contestants sing their best yet again. after each one's performance, they are surprised by the welcoming of their families to the show.

videos.title: New Year Special With Deepika
videos.overview: Today's episode is a New year special with the gorgeous Deepika Padukone. All the contestants dedicate delightful songs to Deepika and take the crowd on the joyful rollercoaster ride. Later, Himesh Reshammiya gave the stage a magical touch with his voice.

videos.title: Senior Citizen Special
videos.overview: Today's episode is about the love and warmth we receive from the Senior Section of our society. To make this event even more special, we have some Senior fans come in for their favourite Idol. The contestants are filled with joy to see their fans enjoying their heart out, while they set the stage on fire.

videos.title: Wild Card Entry Special
videos.overview: The contestants are in for a surprise today, as the Ex-Idols have come back to take their revenge. Also, this time Manish Paul has come to help his fellow students. The contestants perform with the Ex-Idols and make the show ecstatic for the evening. And at the end of the episode, Manish reveals his big surprise to everyone.

videos.title: Alka And Udit Special
videos.overview: The episode starts with inviting Udit Narayan & Alka Yagnik, India's sweetest musical couple, here on the show. They are all fascinated and amazed to hear the contestants. Aditya is, as usual, trying to woo Neha but this time with a little help from his father, Udit Narayan.

videos.title: Varun and Shraddha Jazz Up The Show
videos.overview: It is a star-studded show with Varun Dhawan and Shraddha Kapoor as the special guest. All the contestants astonish everyone with their mind-blowing performances. Sunny makes everyone emotional by singing a heartfelt song. The judges and all the contestants along with Varun and Shraddha have a phenomenal time.

videos.title: 50 Years Of Bappi Da
videos.overview: Today's episode is a special one, this evening the guests are none other than the legend, Bappi Lahiri, along with the whole team of Panga. The guests and all the judges have a spectacular time. Each contestant pays tribute to Bappi Da by singing his amazing famous songs.

videos.title: Team Malang Gets Mesmerized
videos.overview: In this episode, we welcome the team of Malang, Anil Kapoor, Aditya Roy Kapur, Disha Patani and Kunal Khemu. All the contestants pay their tribute To Anil Kapoor by singing his very popular and beautiful songs. Boney Kapoor conveys a warm message to Anil and speaks about his struggle. The guests and the judges along with the contestants have a spectacular time.

videos.title: Republic Day Special
videos.overview: The evening starts in a patriotic note with the contestants cracking up the stage with their songs. The songs portray the love each person has for this beloved country. The audience comprises of the men from the CRPF. A special welcome is given to the IG and the DIG of the CRPF. The contestants dedicate their songs to some real-life heroes who are present among the audience today.

videos.title: Suron Ka Samudramanthan
videos.overview: It’s an evening to remember, an evening to experience, when not only our talented singers, with their enchanting voice, move the planets, but we also read our beloved Kumar Sanu’s book of life. Also, Kumar Sanu doesn’t shy away from making galaxies dance to his tunes.

videos.title: Suron Ki Local
videos.overview: On the eve of hearts, Indian Idol takes a love route, where Aditya expresses his love through untravelled terrain; where voices of talented contestants melt away the listeners’ heart and expose their secrets and past hidden inside their tender hearts. Also, Kartik Aryan and Sara Ali Khan deepen the red of the evening through their laughter and heart pleasing antics.

videos.title: Zeenat Visits Indian Idol
videos.overview: Indian Idol goes even glorious when the beautiful Zeenat Amaan visits the set. Zeenat recalls how she met Dharmendra and gives insight about her film ‘Shalimaar’. She also does a Q&A session by Aditya. However, Zeenat Amaan is not the only star of the episode. Our talented singers sing melodiously. They impress Zeenat Amaan and everyone so much that Himesh and Aditya can’t stop themselves from singing a duet with two of the contestants. Then, everyone sings a medley to show respect to Zeenat Amaan. The episode ends on a hight note with Adriz and Rohit’s heart winning duet.

videos.title: Dharmendra In Indian Idol
videos.overview: The Indian Idol glitters in brilliance when Dharmendra visits them and unveils the Indian Idol trophy. With the shiny Indian Idol Trophy in front of their eyes, the contestants start to perform. Shahzan impresses Dharmendra with his song ‘Mere Dushman’ so much that Dharmendra gives him a standing ovation. Dharmendra talks about his first film. He tells that he felt angry at himself and ran away in the interval and says that he has yet to give his best. Rohit comes and enthrals Dharmendra with his voice. Dharmendra reveals that he is Dilip Kumar fan, and says that he is the one who motivated him to get into movies. He tells everyone a funny incident with Dilip Kumar. Ankona weaves a magic with her voice and receives a standing ovation from everyone. Adriz also doesn’t lag behind and gives an exceptional performance. Ridham floors everyone with ‘Chhalkaye Jaam’, and Sunny shows his talent. In the end duets are performed to honour Dharmendra.

videos.title: Aditya And Neha’s Marriage Ceremony
videos.overview: Since the beginning of season 11, the audience has not only witnessed the contestants’ journey but also Adtiya and Neha’s love affair. It began with Aditya’s never-ending attempts to woo Neha, and finally today, on February the 14th, they are getting married. He first introduces Shahzaan Mujeeb on the stage.
